arp1_dependency.role: Mechanical upload, export, and failure validation is reused. M9B-1 corrected ARP-1 wording without changing its validator. Both pinned hashes are enforced against the files. ARP-2B did not modify ARP-1.

production_design_constants.note: These are production design constants. Synthetic fixture counts are labelled synthetic and are not checked against them.

interpretation_boundary.statement: Uniform controls are a synthetic floor. This package does not interpret binding, affinity, or selectivity, and it defines no combined Tier 1 and Tier 2 score.

private_key_contract.identifier_form: nonempty opaque id with no whitespace, the ARP-1 acceptor
private_key_contract.length_type: positive JSON integer; booleans and floats are rejected
private_key_contract.pair_rule: Each pair has exactly two candidates, one real and one uniform_control, sharing pair_id, parent_core_id, cluster_id, and length. Each parent_core_id belongs to one pair_id. Distinct parent cores may share a cluster.
private_key_contract.type_gate: Identifier and length types are validated before set, sort, or candidate-id lookup.

reconciliation_contract.disposition_rule: Every expected candidate has exactly one validated exported score row or one explicit technical failure with a nonempty reason.
reconciliation_contract.zero_score_rule: A successful exported numeric score of 0 is a real numeric value.
reconciliation_contract.token_rule: Finite aptamer-likeness tokens are preserved. A nonempty group mean is the exact rational sum of those tokens divided by the count. An empty group stays undefined with denominator zero.

report_contract.undefined_representation: An empty group is null, denominator zero, undefined true, and an undefined reason. A defined rational mean is not labelled undefined.
report_contract.exact_mean_representation: exact_numerator and exact_denominator are the reduced integer fraction of the mean. Original score tokens are preserved. value is a terminating decimal string when the expansion terminates. A repeating mean may include decimal_approximation labelled with precision and rounding.
report_contract.duplicate_sequence_scope: Identical canonical A/C/G/U sequences under more than one candidate id are rejected inside the supplied candidate upload only. This does not compare an external known-core inventory and does not close U23.
report_contract.reviewed_specification: The public analysis path loads the on-disk specification and checks every pinned dependency. Caller-supplied specification objects and bytes are refused.
report_contract.paired_effect_reported: eligible count, real-minus-control direction, and blocked functional status

implemented: Validate a synthetic private key before set, sort, or id lookup.
Reuse ARP-1 parsing and mechanical validation for uploads, export rows, and explicit failures.
Join validated export rows and explicit failures to the private key by opaque candidate id.
Account for every expected candidate exactly once.
Construct real and uniform_control pairs without using row position.
Distinguish group-level evaluable rows from complete pairs.
Preserve technical failures as missing technical outcomes and never as numeric zero.
Retain a successful exported score of zero as a numeric value.
Preserve finite aptamer-likeness tokens and represent each nonempty group arithmetic mean as an exact rational.
Require one parent_core_id for each pair_id.
Reject a repeated canonical sequence inside the supplied candidate upload without closing U23.
Report the pre-rejection cluster count from the private key.
Record the real-minus-control direction and the eligible paired-difference count.
Leave unresolved statistical and UI-dependent results blocked.
Record production design constants without enforcing them on synthetic fixtures.

blocked_outputs.reason: Median and IQR stay blocked until the quantile convention in U30 is prespecified.
The real-minus-control direction is fixed. The aggregate paired-effect functional and its confidence interval stay blocked by U31.
AUROC stays blocked. Live score direction is U29 and tie handling is U32.
Shuffle tokens stay uninterpreted. Pass rates and shuffle interpretation stay blocked by U19, U21, and U33.
The secondary paired test stays blocked by U34. No test is selected or computed.
Bootstrap intervals stay blocked by U35, U36, U37, and U38. No resample is drawn.
No component table is supplied by a verified deployment. Local component recomputation stays blocked.
The deployed AptaRank UI is the scorer. Local recomputation of scorer internals stays blocked by U1 through U21.
Uniform-control generation stays blocked by U22, U23, and U24.
Opaque production-id creation stays blocked by U25 and U26.
A full-ranking schema stays blocked by U27, U28, and U29. ARP-1 is unchanged.

unresolved_register.note: The public implementation pools one reference distribution per criterion. It does not implement an MRes short/long split. The project grain remains unchosen, and deployment application is unverified.
The public mid-rank CDF is recorded in the M9B evidence contract. ARP-2B does not adopt it for local recomputation. Live deployment use is unverified.

Lower-favoured direction is fixed for MFE, ensemble defect, and positional entropy. The public transform is 1 minus the mid-rank CDF. It is recorded and not locally recomputed. Deployment use is unverified.
Public stem fraction uses the two-sided score that peaks at mid-rank 0.5. The algebra is recorded in the M9B evidence contract and is not locally recomputed. Deployment use is unverified.
Public GC fraction uses the same two-sided mid-rank transform as stem fraction. It is recorded and not locally recomputed. Deployment use is unverified.
The public CDF places values outside the reference sample on the corresponding tail. No separate winsorization is coded. Deployment use is unverified.

The public default weight of each criterion is 1 and the default composite divides by the sum of positive weights. Config can override both. ARP-2B does not adopt a production weight vector. Deployment use is unverified.
Public code fails a candidate whose criterion column is missing or whose feature is non-finite. It does not impute a component. Deployment policy is unverified.

Public composite scores lie in the unit interval when the components do, and higher scores rank first. The shortlist CSV keeps the full decimal; the UI metric formats three decimals. Live rounding and direction remain unverified.
Public positional entropy is the mean of per-position ViennaRNA entropies. That definition is recorded and not locally recomputed. Deployment use is unverified.

Public folding uses ViennaRNA MFE, ensemble defect of the MFE structure, and uniq_ML set to 1. Other model numbers are installed ViennaRNA defaults. The paper's tool versions are not the future deployment. Local recomputation stays blocked.

The public structural subscore uses normalised MFE, ensemble defect, mean positional entropy, and stem fraction. GC fraction and length are excluded. The set is recorded and not locally recomputed. Deployment use is unverified.
The public structural subscore is the same weighted mean over its four components. It is recorded and not locally recomputed. Deployment use is unverified.

Public presets are quick, standard, and evaluation. Evaluation uses 99 shuffles and 200 samples. The effective MRes preset is unverified. Fast mode in this public commit forces candidate ensemble samples to 0, which conflicts with the paper's quick-run count of 30.
The public per-candidate shuffle seed is derive_seed of the run seed, candidate id, sequence, and the label shuffle. The seed a future UI run uses is unverified.
The public algorithm is ushuffle with k equal to 2. It is recorded and not locally recomputed. Deployment use is unverified.
Public wins are a strictly greater structural subscore. The descriptive percentile gives ties half credit. The p-value counts controls at least as high as the candidate. Deployment use is unverified.

The public p-value is (1 plus the count of controls at least as high) divided by (M plus 1), with pass at p less than or equal to alpha. Default alpha is 0.05. ARP-2B does not adopt it as an export rule. Deployment use is unverified.

Public export pass follows the p-value rule when a shuffle result exists. The supplied camera-ready CSV uses an em dash, which is absence of that boolean, not a pass. Binding the future export to the rule remains unverified.
A public folding failure is separate from shuffle fail. Fast mode disables shuffles. How the live UI will report either remains unverified.
The public shortlist CSV carries pass, fail, or an em dash and does not carry p-values. The JSON artifact carries p-values. Whether a future download matches that split is unverified.
The uniform-control generator and nucleotide index order are not chosen.
Known-core role membership and the digest function are not specified.
The resampling successor rule and attempt cap are not chosen.
The opaque candidate-id format is not frozen.
The opaque-id randomization seed and algorithm are not frozen.
No full-ranking export schema is tracked. ARP-1 is unchanged.
Public code exports a dense rank after sorting higher aptamer-likeness first and breaking ties by ascending candidate id. ARP-2B still does not check that rule. Live ranking remains unverified.
Public code and the supplied CSV order a higher aptamer-likeness first. The live favourable direction remains unverified until M9C.
The median and IQR quantile convention is not selected.
The paired functional that receives the confidence interval is not selected.
AUROC tie handling is not specified.
The shuffle-rate denominator and paired pass difference are not specified.
The secondary paired test is not selected.
Bootstrap replacement, multiplicity, and core-versus-cluster weighting are not specified.
The percentile-interval endpoint convention is not selected.
The policy for undefined bootstrap replicates is not selected. Imputation as zero is forbidden.
Minimum evaluable counts for a defined result are not selected.

rules.opaque_id: Private-key identifiers are nonempty strings in the ARP-1 opaque-id form. Invalid identifier types fail before set, sort, or lookup.
rules.length_type: Length is a positive JSON integer. Booleans and floats are rejected, including integral floats.
rules.unique_candidate_ids: Candidate ids are unique in the private key and in the export.
rules.pair_cardinality: Each pair contains exactly two expected candidates, and every candidate belongs to one pair.
rules.pair_class_composition: Each pair contains exactly one real candidate and one uniform_control candidate.
rules.pair_field_agreement: Both members of a pair share pair_id, parent_core_id, cluster_id, and length. One parent_core_id maps to one pair_id.
rules.join_by_candidate_id: Export rows and failure records are joined to the private key by candidate id. Row position is not a join key.
rules.exactly_one_disposition: An id in both the export and the failure record, in neither, duplicated, missing, or unexpected fails closed.
rules.zero_score_is_numeric: A successful exported score of 0 remains evaluable and is not treated as missing.
rules.technical_failure_not_zero: A technical failure is a missing technical outcome with a nonempty reason. It is not stored as numeric zero.
rules.no_row_position: Permuting export rows does not change the accounting report.
rules.production_counts_not_enforced_on_synthe: The constants 113, 154, 308, and 79 are recorded and are not enforced on synthetic fixtures.
rules.no_local_rescoring: Local code does not recompute normalized MFE, ensemble defect, positional entropy, stem fraction, GC fraction, empirical REF calibration, the composite, dinucleotide shuffles, or shuffle p-values.
rules.no_aggregate_tier_score: ARP-2B defines no combined Tier 1 and Tier 2 score.
rules.no_binding_interpretation: ARP-2B does not interpret binding, affinity, or selectivity.
rules.one_parent_core_per_pair: After identifier type validation, each parent_core_id belongs to exactly one pair_id. The two members of a pair share that parent core. Distinct parent cores may share a cluster. One parent core under two pair ids fails closed as duplicate_parent_core_across_pairs.
rules.duplicate_candidate_sequence: After ARP-1 parses and alphabet-validates the candidate upload, an identical canonical A/C/G/U sequence under more than one candidate id fails closed as duplicate_candidate_sequence. The check covers real/real, control/control, and real/control duplicates inside the supplied upload only. It does not compare an external known-core inventory and does not close U23.
rules.exact_arithmetic_mean: Every nonempty collection of finite exported scores has a defined exact rational mean. exact_numerator and exact_denominator are required. A terminating decimal may also be supplied. A repeating decimal approximation must be labelled with precision and rounding. An empty collection stays undefined with denominator zero. The sum does not use the default Decimal context.
rules.reviewed_specification: The public analysis path always loads the on-disk reviewed specification and enforces the governing-plan hash, the ARP-2A hash, the ARP-2B module hash, and the ARP-1 module and specification hashes. Caller-supplied specification objects and bytes cannot bypass that loader.
